_note: DEVELOPMENT FIXTURE CATALOGUE. Sources are real, revision-pinned Wikipedia articles (tertiary reference works) used only to exercise the product. Editorial content must be researched against primary, official, academic and specialist sources.

sources.title: Ghats in Varanasi
sources.assessment: Tertiary, collaboratively edited reference work (revision 1378685889). Useful orientation; relies on cited secondary works. Not sufficient on its own for editorial publication.

sources.title: Sawai Jai Singh
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1375891413). Contains evaluative language about the ruler that should not be repeated as fact.

sources.title: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1379115214). Summarises UNESCO and historical literature.

sources.title: Jantar Mantar
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1379411375) giving an overview of the five observatories.

sources.title: Hampi
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1380353571). Population estimates it reports are scholarly estimates, not records.

sources.title: Chinese fishing nets
sources.assessment: Short tertiary article (revision 1375589428) with few inline citations. Its statements about origins are inconsistent (stated as fact in one place, as possibility in another) and are treated here as unresolved.

sources.title: Durga Puja in Kolkata
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1380989004). Dates for the earliest household pujas are hedged in the source.

sources.title: Meenakshi Temple
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1377461356) drawing on inscriptions and temple texts such as the Thirupanimalai.

sources.title: Madurai Nayak dynasty
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference work (revision 1380453546). Origins of the dynasty are discussed with competing sources.

sources.title: Sacred lotus in religious art
sources.assessment: Tertiary overview (revision 1352292329) across several religions; summarises symbolism rather than documenting historical transmission.

sources.title: Archaeological & Architectural Documentation of Varanasi Riverfront
sources.creator: Archaeological Survey of India
sources.publisher: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI), Ministry of Culture
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official Government Archive. Documents protected stone embankments, Maratha-period masonry, and ghat structural surveys.

sources.title: Banaras Brocades and Zari: Traditional Craft & GI Heritage
sources.creator: National Mission on Cultural Mapping
sources.publisher: Indian Culture Portal, Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official National Cultural Repository. Details living weaver guilds, kadhwa and fekwa techniques, and historical guild migration.

sources.title: Kashi Tirtha: Sacred Geography, Panchakroshi and Living Rituals
sources.creator: Prof. Rana P.B. Singh
sources.publisher: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA)
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Autonomous Cultural Research Institution. Peer-reviewed spatial and scriptural survey of river-city ritual geography.

sources.title: Geographical Indications Registry: Banaras Brocades and Sarees (GI Application No. 99)
sources.creator: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks
sources.publisher: Geographical Indications Registry, Government of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Statutory Record. Establishes legal definitions, 6-district geography, handloom criteria, and historical origins.

sources.title: The Loom and the Sacred City: Silk Weavers of Madanpura and Peeli Kothi
sources.creator: Sucharita Sengupta
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Specialist Cultural Heritage Documentation. Field interviews with master weavers, Nakshaband lineage, and syncretic guild history.

sources.title: The Ghats of Banaras: Cultural Geography, Architecture and Daily Ritual
sources.creator: V.N. Mishra & Editorial Collective
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Specialist Field Documentation. In-depth architectural profiles of 84 ghats, cremation rites at Manikarnika, and seasonal ritual calendars.

sources.title: Banaras Gharana
sources.assessment: Tertiary overview of the Varanasi musical lineage in tabla, shehnai and vocal thumri.

sources.title: Panchakroshi Yatra
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference describing the circumambulation pilgrimage circuit around Kashi.

sources.title: Sanganeri Print
sources.assessment: Tertiary summary of Sanganeri wooden block printing on white and pale backgrounds.

sources.title: Amer Fort
sources.assessment: Tertiary overview of Amer Fort architecture, Rajput defense design and Maota Lake hydraulics.

sources.title: Vittala Temple, Hampi
sources.assessment: Tertiary documentation of Vijaya Vittala complex, musical pillars and monolithic stone chariot.

sources.title: Tungabhadra River
sources.assessment: Tertiary overview of the Tungabhadra river, coracle navigation and Kishkindha topography.

sources.title: Kathakali
sources.assessment: Tertiary reference on the classical dance-drama of Kerala, facial makeup (vesham) and mudras.

sources.title: Paradesi Synagogue
sources.assessment: Tertiary record of Cochin Jewish heritage, Jew Town, and the historic spice trade nexus.

sources.title: Kumartuli
sources.assessment: Tertiary documentation of the traditional potters' colony in Kolkata sculpting clay Durga idols.

sources.title: Adda (social gathering)
sources.assessment: Tertiary overview of Bengali intellectual discourse and Coffee House adda culture.

sources.title: Chithirai Festival
sources.assessment: Tertiary documentation of the annual Madurai festival uniting Saivite and Vaishnavite traditions.

sources.title: Madurai Sungudi
sources.assessment: Tertiary record of GI-tagged tie-and-dye cotton sarees made by Saurashtrian weavers in Madurai.

sources.title: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Monument Portal
sources.publisher: Archaeological Survey of India, Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Principal Statutory Authority for archaeological research, protected monuments, and antiquities.

sources.title: Ministry of Culture, Government of India
sources.publisher: Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official policy and national cultural heritage repository body.

sources.title: Indian Culture Portal & National Virtual Library of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Centralized National Virtual Library housing digitized manuscripts, archives, music, and UNESCO records.

sources.title: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage — India Inscriptions
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Canonical International Charter and nomination dossier records for India's inscribed living heritage.

sources.title: Durga Puja in Kolkata — Inscribed 2021 (16.COM 8.b.14)
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official nomination file, documentary photographs, and living heritage dossier.

sources.title: Geographical Indications Registry of India
sources.publisher: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks, DPIIT
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Statutory Register of all certified Geographical Indications in India.

sources.title: Office of the Development Commissioner (Handlooms)
sources.publisher: Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Statutory record of registered weaver cooperative clusters, pit-loom census, and GI yarn specifications.

sources.title: Sangeet Natak Akademi — National Academy of Music, Dance and Drama
sources.publisher: Sangeet Natak Akademi, Ministry of Culture
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Apex national body for classical performing arts, Gharana archives, and master performer fellowships.

sources.title: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) Heritage Archives
sources.publisher: Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Autonomous cultural research institution specializing in Indology, manuscripts, and ethnomusicology.

sources.title: Sahapedia Open Cultural Heritage Archive
sources.assessment: Tier-2 Scholar-curated open encyclopedia of multimedia, photo essays, oral histories, maps, and timelines.

sources.title: Indian National Trust for Art and Cultural Heritage (INTACH)
sources.assessment: Tier-2 Non-profit conservation trust for built heritage listings, municipal registers, and conservation dossiers.

sources.title: National Crafts Museum & Hastkala Academy, New Delhi
sources.publisher: Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
sources.assessment: Tier-1 National museum collection of living craft traditions, master artisan tools, and regional textiles.

sources.title: Keezhadi Excavation Reports & Vaigai River Valley Civilization
sources.publisher: Tamil Nadu State Department of Archaeology
sources.assessment: Tier-1 Official state archaeological survey reports on Sangam-era urbanism, Tamil-Brahmi pottery, and brick structures.
